nodes.label: Jolpica API (Ergast successor)

nodes.label: Replay laps mode (1996+)
nodes.rationale: Uses Jolpica cumulative lap times where no GPS exists

nodes.label: SETTLED disk-cached Jolpica client
nodes.rationale: Past seasons and races >3 days old cannot change, so use basef1 client with sqlite disk cache (.cache/jolpica.sqlite); recent data uses livef1 5 min in-memory cache

nodes.label: Live GPS with mini-sector fallback
nodes.rationale: hasGps falls back to mini-sector placement once samples stop for 5 s; liveGps/gpsAt interpolate ~1.8 s behind the feed

nodes.label: F1 TV see-through telemetry overlay
nodes.rationale: session_telemetry covers whole session, cached under its own _tv tag because telemetry() cache ignores start

nodes.label: F1 TV 4K mode
nodes.rationale: x-f1-override-video-stream HDR_UHD_DASH header adds 2160p50 HEVC Main10; preferredVideoCodecs hvc1.2 and minHeight 2160 needed because shaka keeps one video set; disabled where mediaCapabilities cannot decode

nodes.label: F1 TV replay clock offset
nodes.rationale: Replays are static DASH from 0 s with no prft/PDT, so video 0 s is placed at scheduled start minus LEAD (308 s measured on 2026 US GP) plus per-video localStorage offset set by nudges or Lights out

nodes.label: F1 TV start-up tuning
nodes.rationale: ignoreMinBufferTime cut first-frame delay from 12 s to 2 s; load with startTime so joining tile skips session start; bandwidth estimate from navigator.connection

nodes.label: shaka-player
nodes.rationale: Plays F1 TV DASH under custom control bar; loaded from jsDelivr and pre-loaded when F1 TV list opens

nodes.label: pitTrace real pit lane
nodes.rationale: Derived from a GPS pit stop in a replay; circuit3d draws pit lane and moves the barrier

nodes.label: Known dead ends (Oct 2026)
nodes.rationale: Old livetiming /static and /signalr return 401 so livef1 session data unavailable; livef1 f1.com results scrape 404s; livef1.get_season(2010) raises

nodes.label: F1 TV subscription token auth
nodes.rationale: Position.z and CarData.z silently omitted without token; sign in like FastF1 via PingOne OAuth+PKCE; credentials from env or gitignored .cache, never in source; 10 min back-off after failure

nodes.label: F1 TV catalogue and playback
nodes.rationale: MultiViewer-style viewer using public catalogue search plus subscription token as ascendontoken for signed DASH manifest; replays have no DRM, live streams are Widevine (untested)

nodes.label: livef1 library 1.2.11
nodes.rationale: Bundles jolpica_client; many of its data paths are dead

nodes.label: MultiViewer circuit data
nodes.rationale: Track outlines share coordinate system with OpenF1 car positions; MV_KEYS maps Jolpica circuitId to MultiViewer key; supplies pitLoss and minisectors

nodes.label: No-build vanilla JS ES modules served at /static
nodes.norm_label: no-build vanilla js es modules served at /static
nodes.rationale: Frontend avoids a build step; three.js via import map in index.html

nodes.label: OpenF1 API
nodes.rationale: Free tier ~30 req/min; a GPS replay costs ~30 requests; answers 401 while any session is live

nodes.label: OpenF1Locked live fallback
nodes.rationale: While a session is live OpenF1 returns 401, so season meetings/sessions are kept in .cache/openf1 and /api/season falls back to livef1; /api/replay answers 409 LIVE_NOW

nodes.label: Replay gps mode (2023+)
nodes.rationale: Location resampled to 0.5 s grid; event feeds time-sorted for browser binary search

nodes.rationale: Pure-JS race sim with grid from Jolpica results; opened from circuit selector or Race this era
